You helped Siflind to defend Svargrond. Now Nilsor need help, go ask him for mission.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 1st of 7 ingredients: a Part of the Sun Adorer Cactus. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 2nd of 7 ingredients: Geyser Water in a Waterskin. Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 3rd of 7 ingredients: Fine Sulphur. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 4th of 7 ingredients: the Frostbite Herb. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 5th of 7 ingredients: Purple Kiss Blossom. The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom.
To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 6th of 7 ingredients: the Hydra Tongue. The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop.

To cure Nilsor dogs, bring him the 7th of 7 ingredients: Spores of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom. The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores.
You found all ingredients to cure Nilsor dogs, ask him for mission. You can now travel by Dog Sleds to Inukaya.
Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
Hjaern send you to find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek the reason for the unrest there.
You discovered the necromantic altar and should report Hjaern about it.
Get out of Nibelor and go to the Svargrond Explorer's Society. Ask Lurik for the mission.
Get to the raider camp, then follow to the extreme south where you find lots of barbarians. Near the southern most coastline, try looking for the NPC Nor. Ask him about Memory Crystal.
Go back to Lurik and deliver him the memory crystal.
Give Lurik some time to evaluate the information (ca. 5min). Then talk to him again about your mission.
Find the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. Find some hint or someone who is willing to talk about what is going on there.
You found a old and tattered written paper in a skeleton next to a Restless Soul, you can only make out a signature: Tylaf, apprentice of Hjaern. Ask Hjaern about Tylaf.
Go back to the mine and ask the restless soul about his story.
You already have listen to his story!
The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
The Cultists plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans are already informed!
Hjaern gave you a spirit charm of cold. Travel to the mines and find four special obelisks to mark them with the charm.
1 of 4 obelisks are marked.
2 of 4 obelisks are marked.
3 of 4 obelisks are marked.
Once all 4 obelisks are marked report back to Hjaern.
You got the Norseman outfit and you have access to the Yakchal room deep in the Formorgar Mines.
You participate in the drinking challenge. Now you can get the permission for a few sips of barbarian mead in exchange for some honey.
Now drink from the bucket until you drink 10 sips in a row without passing out
You have mastered the first task of the barbarian test. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.
Somewhere north of Svargrond you will find a lonely bear which you have to hug. You wonder what you were thinking when accepting this quest...
You passed the bear hugging test (and should take a bath). If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about it.
Find a mammoth north-west of Svargrond and knock it over. You wonder whether your mission is becoming a barbarian or rather commiting suicide.
You have knocked over a mammoth - though you wonder what this crushing noise at your spine was. If you haven't done so yet, talk to Sven about the mammoth pushing.
You are now a honorary barbarian and can become a citizen of Svargrond. If you haven't done so yet, you should look for a barbarian in need of help in the north of the town.
Your mission is to investigate the 5 guards in Thais regarding the Heretic behavior. Tim, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Walter are their names. If you do well you see a holy sprite on you.
You investigated 1 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 2 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 3 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 4 of 5 guards in Thais.
You investigated 5 of 5 guards in Thais. Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You investigated all guards in Thais.

Henricus tells you to get The Witches' Grimoire, he sends you to Femor Hills where you can fly to the witches' mountain, say Eclipse to Uzon and he will take you there. Use the vial of holy water that he gives you on the big cauldron and open the chest to your left, then bring the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
Find the witches' grimoire and bring it to Henricus.
You already brought the witches' grimoire to Henricus.
Henricus wants you to find the Dwarfish Vampire Hunter, Storkus, located west of the Dwarf Bridge. It's good idea bring your 20 Vampire Dusts with you to save some time.
Go Back to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.

Now Storkus wants you to kill a vampire lord, The Count in the Green Claw Swamp, The Count is located near to the Blood Herb Quest. To summon The Count, you must use the coffin in the center of the room. Kill it and bring The Ring of the Count to Storkus.
Kill The Count and bring his ring to Storkus the Dwarf and ask for Mission.
Return to Henricus and tell him that you finished your job here.
Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
Henricus will gave you a Special Flask (vial of holy water). Go to Liberty Bay and use the vial on an old house. Use this vial of holy water on that spot to drive out the evil being.
Kill the Pirate Ghost and get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
You already cleaned the abandoned and haunted house in Liberty, ask Henricus for mission.
Henricus wants 20 Demonic Essences as a proof of your accomplishments.
Now ask Henricus for outfit to get the Demon Hunter Outfit.
You got the Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.
Henricus wants you to kill a demon called Ungreez. Head to Edron Hero Cave and go down a few levels.
You killed Ungreez, report your mission to Henricus.
You got the the first addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Ask Henricus for mission to unlock more addons.
Your mission is to go to the Demon Forge and slay seven of The Ruthless Seven Minions. The Demon Forge is located in the Edron Hero Cave, through a portal after the Vampire Shield Quest.
You destroyed the shadow nexus! Get back to Thais and report your mission to Henricus.
Now ask to Henricus for a outfit. He will give you the 2nd addon of the Demon Hunter Outfits.
You got the the second addon of Demon Hunter Outfit! Go now to the reward room and choose one wisely!
You have completed The Inquisition Quest! You can now buy the Blessing of the Inquisition!
Kevin wants you to travel with Captain Bluebear to Carlin.
Kevin wants you to travel with Uzon in Femor Hills to Edron.
Kevin wants you to travel with Captain Seahorse to Venore.
Kevin wants you to travel with Brodrosch to Cormaya
You have checked the Postal Routes, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to fix one of their Mailboxes located on Folda with a crowbar.
You have fixed the mailbox, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to deliver a bill to the stage magician David Brassacres. He's hiding from his creditors somewhere in Venore.
You have delivered the bill to the stage magician David Brassacres, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin has asked you to deliver 20 Bones to him.
You have delivered 20 Bones to Kevin.
Kevin has asked you to retrieve the present behind the door on the lower right side of his room and deliver it to Dermot in Fibula.
Deliver the present to Dermot in Fibula.
You have delivered the present to Dermot, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin has asked you to travel to Venore and negotiate with Hugo for new uniforms.
Hugo said that his dog ate the last dress pattern they used and he has no clue where Kevin Postner got it from, go ask Kevin.
Kevin wants you to ask the great Technomancer Talphion in Kazordoon for the technical details.
Talphion will send a copy to Kevin, report back to Kevin.
Kevin wants you to ask Queen Eloise of Carlin for the perfect colours.
Queen Eloise said she will send some color samples via mail to Kevin, report back to Kevin.
Kevin has asked you to go to Noodles and find out what he dislikes the most: mouldy cheese, a piece of fur or a banana skin.
Noodles seems to like banana skin, check if he likes dirty fur.
Noodles seems to like dirty fur, check if he likes mouldy cheese.
Noodles dislikes mouldy cheese! Report back to Kevin.
Kevin wants you to tell Hugo that they order those uniforms.
Hugo has agreed to make the uniforms, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to bring him the measurements of Benjamin, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik.
You have received the measurements from 1 of 6 post officers.
You have received the measurements from 2 of 6 post officers.
You have received the measurements from 3 of 6 post officers.
You have received the measurements from 4 of 6 post officers.
You have received the measurements from 5 of 6 post officers.
You have received all measurements, report back to Kevin!
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to find the missing courier Waldo or at least his posthorn.
You have found Waldos posthorn.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to deliver som letters to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have retrieved the letters, deliver them to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have delivered the letters to Santa Claus on Vega.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Kevin wants you to deliver a letter  to Markwin, king of Mintwallin from his mother.
You have delivered the letter to Markwin.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission.
Assistant Postman
Postman
Grand Postman
Grand Postman for Special Operations
Arch Postman
You need to return to Marina and ask her for a date with Ocelus.
You need to return to Ocelus with the bad news.
Ocelus told you to get a poem for him, if you didn't buy one already, head to Ab'Dendriel and buy a Love Poem from Elvith.
You need to go recite the poem to Marina and impress her with the Djinn's romantic and poetic abilities.
After reciting the poem to Marina, she decided to date Ocelus and release Ray Striker from her spell.
You need to find the man-stealing mermaid and try to break her spell over poor Raymond, the mermaid Marina is near the northern coast of the island.
You discovered that she does in fact have a spell on him, and will not release him unless someone better comes along.
You are a true master in reciting love poems now. No mermaid will be able to resist if you ask for a date!

missions.name: Access to Goroma
missions.description: After helping Jack Fate to collect the 30 woodpieces, Jack Fate in Liberty Bay will bring you to Goroma.

missions.name: Access to Laguna Island
missions.description: After arranging a date for Marina and Ocelus, you are allowed to use Marina's sea turtles. They will bring you to the idyllic Laguna Islands.

missions.name: Access to Meriana
missions.description: After earning the trust of the governor's daughter Eleonore, Captain Waverider in Liberty Bay will bring you to Meriana if you tell him the secret codeword 'peg leg'.

missions.name: Access to Nargor
missions.description: After convincing the people in Sabrehaven that you are a trustworthy hero, Sebastian will sail you to Nargor.

states.description: Ray Striker asked you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire. When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'.
Sandra will be enraged and will cut any deals with pirates. Report back to Raymond Striker.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about Sandra's rage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.
Buy a fire bug at Liberty Bay and infiltrate Nargor. Find the pirates' harbor and use the fire bug to sabotage their catapult there.
You were able to sabotage the catapult in the pirate's harbor. Report back to Ray Striker to tell him about mission.
Ray Striker was pleased to hear about successful sabotage. If you haven't done so yet, ask him for other missions.
Travel to Nargor and try to enter de pirate's tavern by deceiving the guard in front of it. Read all the plans which you can find in the tavern and report back to Striker.
You studied all of the pirate's plans in their tavern which will give insight about their next strikes. If you haven't done so yet, ask Ray for another mission.
Travel to Nargor and try to find out more about the mission Klaus offers. He apparently wants the death of Ray Striker and your task is to convince him that Ray is dead.
Klaus told you to kill Ray Striker and bring him his lucky pillow as a proof. Ray should be interested in hearing about this mission.
You informed Ray that Klaus needs his lucky pillow as proof of his death. Ray gave it to you, now go convince Klaus that the mission is fulfilled and Ray is Dead!
Klaus belieaves that Ray Striker is dead and will celebrate a big party. You should tell Ray about your successful mission.
Ray was very impressed to hear about your successful mission and gave you a ship and a pirate outfit as reward.
Ariella asked you for a few days of adequate supply. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished one mission. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Morgan asked you to deliver a letter safely to old Eremo on Cormaya. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You delivered the letter safely to old Eremo. Report back to Morgan and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished two missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Duncan requested an atlas of the explorers society. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished three missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Chondur asked at least five pirate voodoo dolls to lift the curse. Help him and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished four missions. Ask around in Sabrehaven and surroundings whether the people there might have missions for you. This will improve your reputation and earn their trust.
Ariella asked you to bring a sample of whisper beer from a secret whisper bar in Carlin. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
Take the sample of whisper beer to Ariella. Help her and improve your reputation in Sabrehaven.
You have finished five missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
You have finished six missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.
You have finished seven missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to start trusting you. Maybe this is a good time for some more difficult missions.

missions.name: Reputation in Sabrehaven: Cordial
missions.description: You have finished eight missions. People in Sabrehaven seem to trust you, but there is still one last mission left.

states.description: You have finished nine missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them.
You have finished all missions. People in Sabrehaven are considering you as one of them and you earned their full trust.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead chicken so that he can begin to create a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead rat so that he can continue creating a counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You have begun Chondur's ritual. Bring him a fresh dead black sheep so that he can complete his counterspell which will allow you to pass the magical barrier on Goroma.
You may pass the energy barrier on Goroma. The counterspell Chondur created for you with his ritual will allow you to withstand the evil magic of the cultist.
You told Eleonore to run a small errand. Deliver the 200 gold pieces she gave to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of Liberty Bay.
You delivered the gold to Charlotta. Return to Eleonore and tell her the secret password: peg leg
You promised to find Eleonore's lost ring. She told you that a parrot stole it from her dressing table and flew to the nearby mountains. You might need a rake to retrieve the ring.
You found the ring. Return it to Eleonore.
You returned the ring to Eleonore.
Dorian wants you to collect 10 elephant tusks and deliver them to him.
You delivered the ten tusks to Dorian.
Dorian wants you to steal a vase from Sarina, the owner of Carlin's general store.
You have stolen the vase, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the stolen vase to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Your task is to somehow convince Oswald to hand you an invitation to the king's ball.
You have received the invitation to the King's ball, report back to Dorian!
You have delivered the invitation to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Dorian wants you to find a forger in the outlaw camp, go talk to Snake eye.
Snake Eye told you to visit Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
Ahmet told you that he will only help a friend and asked you to kill at least one Nomad.
You have killed a Nomad, go back to Ahmet!
You have received the forged documents from Ahmet, next is to get a disguise from Percybald in Venore!
You have received the dwarf disguise from Percybald. Now go do the deal with Nurik.
You have traded the forged documents for the painting, report back to Dorian.
You have delivered the painting to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Your mission is to travel to Tiquanda. Fina a hidden smuggler cave to the north of Port Hope and try to retrieve the valuable goblet which Dorian is looking for. Once you got it, bring it to him.
You have delivered the golden goblet to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Dorian wants you to fishnap Theodore Loveless' fish, first you need to get the key to his room. Talk to Chantalle in Liberty Bay.
You have received the key for Theodore Loveless' room, time to fishnap his fish!
You have fishnapped Theodore Loveless' fish, deliver it to Dorian.
You have delivered the fish to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Your current task is to find compromising information about one of the Venore city guards, no matter how. A good starting point might be in their barracks.
You have delivered the compromising letter to Dorian, ask him for a new mission!
Dorian wants you to deliver a message to his competitors in the dark cathedral.
You have put up the message, report back to Dorian.
You have reported back that you have completed the mission, Dorian now allows you to trade with Black Bert.
Your first mission for becoming a recognized trader is to bring the traveling salesman Rashid a Deer Trophy.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
Your mission is to get the package from Willard the weapon dealer at Edron.
Willard forgot to pick it up from Snake Eye at Outlaw Camp. So he wants you to go and pick it up from Snake Eye.
Take the package just next door.
Now bring back the package to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
Rashid wants you to pick his special order from Miraia in Darashia. But you have to be quick, Scarab cheese can rot really fast in high temperature.
Now quickly bring back the Scarab cheese to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
Rashid have ordered a special elven vase from Briasol in Ab'Dendriel. He asks you to buy it from Briasol and bring it back. But you should be carefully, since the vase is very fragile.
Now carefully bring the vase back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
This time, Rashid is testing your trading skills to buy a Crimson Sword from Uzgod. But it have to be less than 400 gold coins and the quality has to be perfect.
Now bring the sword back to Rashid.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
Rashid wants you to bring him a Goldfish Bowl.
You have completed this mission. Talk with Rashid to continue.
Rashid has declare you as one of his recognized traders, and now you are able to trade with him anytime..
The mission should be simple to fulfil. You have to seek out Uzgod in Kazordoon and get the pickaxe for us. Or just find dwarven pickaxe on your own...
Get into Dwacatra and get Uzgod's family brooch.
Bring family brooch back to Uzgod
Bring the pickaxe back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed Joining the Explorers
Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can. If the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway.
You have 10 minutes before the icicle defrosts. Run back to the Explorer Society representative!
You have completed The Ice Delivery.
This preparation kit will allow you to collect a PURPLE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a PURPLE butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for another butterfly hunt.
This preparation kit will allow you to collect a BLUE butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a BLUE butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for another butterfly hunt.
This preparation kit will allow you to collect a RED butterfly you have killed. Just use it on the fresh corpse of a RED butterfly.
Return the prepared butterfly to Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Butterfly Hunt.
Take botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
Use botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
Ask for plant collection when you are ready to continue.
Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample.
Report about your plant collection to Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Plant Collection.

In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people. Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the urn. Acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda.
Bring the Funeral Urn back to the Explorer Society.
You have completed The Lizard Urn.
Travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid. If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath.
Bring the Wrinkled Parchment back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Bonelord Secret.

As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city. There you should find lots of their war wolves and hopefully also some of the orcish powder.
Bring the Strange Powder to the Explorer Society representative to complete your mission.
You have completed The Orc Powder.
This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel Hellgate beneath Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
Bring back an elven poetry book to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Elven Poetry.
In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone.
Bring back a memory stone to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Memory Stone.

Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards. Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure.
Report back to the Explorer Society representative.
You have completed The Rune Writings.
Take ectoplasm container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain.
Return back to the Explorer Society representative with the collected ectoplasm.
The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. Try to get a spectral dress from her.
Report to the Explorer Society with the spectral dress.
Please travel to our second base and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
Take the spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our second base.
Good! Now use the spectral essence on the strange carving in our second base.
Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. You are able to travel in zero time from one base to the other, but you need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source.
Travel to Okolnir and try to find a proof for the existence of dragon lords there in the old times. I think old Buddel might be able to bring you there.
Report back to Lurik with the dragon scale.

There is a cave on Hrodmir, north of the southernmost barbarian camp Krimhorn. In this cave, there are a waterfall and a lot of stalagmites. Take the resonance crystal and use it on the stalagmites in the cave to record the sound of the wind.
Report back to Lurik.
Now you may use the Astral Bridge from Liberty Bay to Svargrond.
Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
Report about your Calassa mission to Berenice in Liberty Bay.
Congratulations, you completed the remaining part of this mission!
You have to defeat all enemies in this mode.
You have defeated all enemies in this mode.
You have to defeat all enemies in this mode.
You have defeated all enemies in this mode.
You have to defeat all enemies in this mode.
You have defeated all enemies in this mode.

missions.name: Access to the Isle of Kings

states.description: You are a friend of Dalbrect. Since you returned his family brooch he will sail you to the Isle of Kings unless you do something stupid.
Investigate the catacombs. Abbot Costello should be interested in information about brother Fugio.
You returned Fugio's Diary. Costello was very thankful about your help and gave you a blessed ankh as reward.
Kazzan sent you to talk with Ubaid and Umar to offer an appeasement treaty to the Djinn races. Talk to Umar first.
Umar said he won't be part of Kazzan's plans. Now you need to try with Ubaid.
Umar and Ubaid said they won't be part of those plans. Return to Kazzan and collect your reward.
You have completed the quest!
Arito asked you to make a peace agreement between him and the Nomads.
Return to Arito and tell him the good news.
Now Arito are safe and you have access to Nomads Cave.
You have passed the three tests of Lion's Rock and thus lit the three mystical pyramids. You may enter the inner sanctum now. - What other secrets could be hidden down there?
You found a mysterious scroll in the debris of an old amphora. It seems it could help to translate the old temple inscriptions.

In the north-west area of the Inner Sanctum, find the southern rectangular room to the south-west. In this room you will find 4 "sun" floor inscriptions as well as a rock in the center. The sun inscriptions represent gem slots.
By solving the gem puzzle you unveiled the last secret of the Lion's Rock. You drew a treasure out of the ornamented fountain in the lower temple areas.
Daniel Steelsoul in Edron wants you to infiltrate the Edron Orc Cave and destroy 4 Spider Eggs.
You destroyed 1 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed 2 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed 3 of 4 Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave
You destroyed all Spider Eggs in the Edron Orc Cave, report back to Daniel Steelsoul!
You have completed the Quest!

Rabaz in Farmine asked you to collect samples from rare plant specimen in Zao. Go to the storage room to the west and receive the Botany Almanach. Find then the Giant Dreadcoil and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
Now you must find the second plant, a Giant Verminous and use your Obsidian Knife on it to obtain a sample.
You found the two samples, report back to Rabaz in Farmine!
You have completed the Quest!
Search the Cursed Bone Pit in the dungeon north of Thais and dig for a well-preserved human bone for Muriel.
You have found a desecrated bone for Muriel.
You helped Muriel to obtain a desecrated bone.
Go to the white raven monastery and ask for some holy water for Amanda.
You got the holy water from the white raven monastery. Go back to Amanda and report about your mission.
Sanctify every single grave at the unholy graveyard north of Edron with the holy water.
You have sanctified all graves at the unholy graveyard of Edron. Report about your mission at Amanda.
You helped Amanda by sanctifying the cursed graveyard of Edron.
Padreia in Carlin asked you to exterminate the slimes in the sewers of Carlin by poisoning their spawn pool.
You poisoned the spawn pool of the slimes in the sewers of Carlin. Report to Padreia about your mission.
You successfully helped Padreia in saving Carlin from a slimy disease.
Boozer in Vernore asked you to bring him some special dwarven brown ale. You may find some in the brewery in Kazordoon.
You found the special dwarven brown ale. Bring it to Boozer in Vernore.
You have completed The Ultimate Booze Quest!
Spectulus told you about a failed experiment he once did, involving an intern named Jack, and asked you to help him rescue Jack. Go to Jack's house and talk to him about Spectulus.
You have talked to Jack and found out that he is not remembering the time accident or Spectulus. Return to Spectulus in the Edron Academy to tell him about your findings.
Spectulus wants you to trigger Jack's memory. Jack used to like his red cushioned chair, an old globe, a telescope, a large amphora and a rocking horse. Place those in his room and ask him about it.
You have talked to Jack about the furniture you placed in his house. Report it back to Spectulus in the Edron Academy.
Spectulus sent you once again to his former intern Jack. Explain the incident to the people close to him. Talk to Jack's mother and sister and return to Spectulus to report their reaction.
You have talked with Jack's mother and sister. Report it back to Spectulus.
Spectulus suggested asking Jack abouthis hobbies. Make Jack leave his hobby be by whateber means it takes. Only by doing this he will be separated from what distracts him from his former self.
You found out and destroyed Jack's hobby. Jack is now finally ready and beginning to change. He event seems to start remembering Spectulus and the Academy.
Jack is finally remembering Spectulus and the Academy. Report back your mission.
Spectulus found out that you were convincing the wrong Jack. His real intern was transported way back to the past. He left a note years ago which, to your misery, reached Spectulus a little too late.
A pirate told you about an evil artifact down in the crystal caves under Nargor.It is a big crystal that affects the caves in a negative manner. Perhaps a jarring,very loud sound could destroy it.
You found an old inscription to a mysterious recipe: 'vial of emb... fl... and mix ... a medusa's bl... Then ... the dust of ... crystal ... get Medusa's Ointm... able to unpetrify ...'
You mixed the proper ingredients to create a special salve. The Medusa's Ointment. With this balm you may unpetrify a petrified object.
With the Medusa's Ointment you unpetrified a banshee's scream near the evil crystal. Thus the baleful artefact was destroyed. You should return to One-Eyed Joe.
You have completed the Quest!
You have talked to Corym Ratter. He asked you to find the reason why the amount of  delivered ores is decreasing. You got access to the mine.
You have met Corym Servant. He told you the true story of enslaved corym working under  terrible conditions. You have agreed to help him planing a riot. First you have to liberate his comrades.
You have found two key fragments. They are quite rusted. It is necessary to remove the  rust before forging them together. You have to find a way to rebuild the key. This might open the doors.
With the forged key you have unlocked the three areas. The Corym Servant was very relieved  and asked you to bring 20 units of rare earth.
You have brought 20 units of rare earth to Corym Servant. He was very thankful and gave you  a reward. The revolution should now take place as intended.
Budrik asked you to look for the hideout of the Horned Fox and bring his stolen mining helmet back. The Fox's lair is presumed to be west of Kazordoon near the coast.
You succesfully helped Budrik in stealing back his old mining helemt.
Your first task is to bring 5 fish.
Your second task is to bring 5 northern pike.
Your third task is to bring 5 green perch.
Your forth task is to bring 5 rainbow trout.
You bring enough fish to make the bait. Now you're ready for the hunt.

missions.name: The hunt for the Sea Serpent

states.description: You navigated the ship to the right location. You are now able to dive down and explore the caves.
Your mission is to find the Holy Skull. It is in a cave in the northern orc settlement, which is located north-west on the Zao Steppe.
You found the Holy Skull. Retrieve it to Lazaran in the Zao Mountains.
You brought Lazaran the Holy Skull. Ask him for new mission!
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Edron.
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Ab'dendriel.
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Femor Hills.
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Darashia
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Ankrahmun
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Port Hope
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Liberty Bay
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Yalahar
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Svargrond
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Thais
You received the Skull of a Caveman and need to explore the world, letting the skull see everything. You need to stand at the highest place of Carlin
You visited all the highest places with the skull. Turn the skull back to Lazaran and report him your mission!
You turned the skull already back to Lazaran. Ask him for new mission!
Lazaran told you to go to Ulala, who is located above Lazaran.
Ulala told you to dance to please their god Krunus. On the south mountain in the camp you will find the Krunus altar, there are lots of leaves on the ground.
You solved the dance. Head back to Ulala and report your mission!
Now the god Krunus is pleased, another god called Pandor needs to be pleased. Ulala wants you to collect 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Bring them to her.
You brought Ulala 5 Orc Teeth, 5 Minotaur leathers and 5 Lizard Leathers. Ask her for new mission!
The third god which needs to be pleased is called Fasuon. Find the great crystal on top of mountain of Fasuon and pray there for his support!
You already prayed at the great crystal. Report it to Ulala
You have reported back to Ulala that you have completed the mission.
Speak with Lazaran and tell the gods are pleased now.
Bring Lazaran a Pot of brown water for a party after the great hunt.
You brought Lazaran the beer and got a Serpent Crest as reward!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Tasks of a Fool

states.description: Cut a flower at the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your first mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - That stinks!

states.description: It sometimes stinks to be a fool. Collect some noxious fumes from a recently slain slime with the special vial. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your second mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A Piece of Cake

states.description: Get 12 pies from Mirabell in Edron. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have finished your third mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Fool Spirits

states.description: Get 18 vials of wine for Bozo. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Exchange the crates in front of Xodet's house and return to Bozo with the swapped crate.
You have finished your fourth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Watch out for the foolish

states.description: Steal the magic watch from the Triangle Tower west of Jakundaf Desert. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Use the magic watch to steal the beard of the sleeping dwarven emperor.
You have already finished five missions for that fool. You should definitely talk to Bozo about your jester outfit now!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The queen of farts

states.description: Get Bozo 4 pieces of minotaur leather.
Get Bozo a piece of giant spider silk.
Ask Bozo about your mission, he might be finished with the whoopee cushion by now.
Place the whoopee cushion on the queen's throne in Carlin by using the cushion with the throne.
You have finished your sixth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - For your mice only

states.description: Get the toy mouse of Queen Eloise's cat and show it to Carina, the jeweler in Venore, to scare her.
You have finished your seventh mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - Smoking is a foolish thing

states.description: Gather some easily inflammable sulphur using a spoon on an inactive lava hole.
You brought Bozo the sulphur. Now cut him some leaves of the jungle dweller bush with a kitchen knife.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Deliver the exploding cigar to Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay.
You have finished your eighth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A fool's bargain

states.description: Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the blood of a stalker. Use the vial on a slain stalker immediately after his death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
Bozo wants you to fill a vial with the ink of a quara constrictor. Use the vial on a slain constrictor immediately after its death. Then report to Bozo about your mission.
You have gathered the ordered ingredients and should ask Bozo for the next mission.
Order 2000 steel shields from Sam. Sign his contract with the magic ink.
You have finished your ninth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - A sweet surprise

states.description: Deliver a cookie to Avar Tar, Simon, Ariella, Lorbas, King Markwin, Hjaern, Wyda, Hairycles, the orc king and EITHER Yaman OR Nah'Bob. Then report to Bozo about the mission.
You have finished your tenth mission and should ask Bozo for the next mission.

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - The final foolishness

states.description: Gather 5 pieces of white cloth for Bozo. Then report about your mission.
Travel to Darama and climb the highest point of the Plague Spike to give these pieces of white cloth an old and worn look. Some ancient altar should suit your needs best - use the white cloth on it.
Use your mummy disguise to scare the caliph Kazzan in Darashia. DON'T use the disguise too early or you will fail the quest.
You have finished all of Bozo's missions and you are a complete fool now. Yay!

missions.name: What a foolish Quest - To become a complete fool

states.description: Now that you have a basic outfit, you should talk to Bozo about your missions to gain further rewards.
You must bring Zalamon 3 nails and a piece of wood so that he can make a Marked Crate for you.

Go to the tunnel in eastern Muggy Plains and reach the other side. Try to hide in the dark and avoid being seen at all by using the crate. After that you need to find the rebel hideout and talk to their leader Chartan.
You passed the maintenance tunnel and successfully made contact with the resistance in their hideout north of the Great Gate.
Chartan needs you to reactivate the teleport to the Muggy Plains. Head downstairs and into the temple and craft material to repair the teleport. To do this you will need some tools to improvise.
As you give the coal into the pool the corrupted fluid begins to dissolve, leaving purified, refreshing water. The teleporter is reactivated. Report back to Chartan.
Report back to Zalamon for the next mission.
Zalamon gives you a Flask of Plant Poison to destroy plants in the garden of the Emperor to lure out and kill The Keeper to get his tail. The garden is southeast of the rebel hideout.
You killed the Keeper and got his tail. Bring it to Zalamon.
You brought the tail of the Keeper to Zalamon and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.

Zalamon now wants you to go to Deeper Banuta and get an Ancient Sceptre that will help in the fight against the emperor. On each floor under Deeper Banuta you collect a sceptre part from a Ghost of a Priest. On the 4th and final floor you need to assemble the sceptre..
After you've assembled the Snake Sceptre and fought your way back out, head back to Zalamon and give it to him.
You have delievered the recreated sceptre to the rebels.
Enter the imperial city Razachai to the west and talk to your contact in the ministry there for further missions.
Now you only have to walk west until you find Zlak inside the big green building.
You went deep inside the city to find Zlak and completed the mission. Ask for the next mission.
Use the old escape tunnel in the northern basement of the ministry to enter the imperial palace. Fight your way to the basement to meet your new rebel contact.
You have reached your rebel contact Zizzle in the imperial palace.
To enter the inner realms of the Emperor you need to free the mind of a dragon. An interdimensional potion will help you to enter this dream and unleash his consciousness.
You travelled through the Sleeping Dragon dreams and freed his mind.
After solving the riddle, and talking again to the Sleeping Dragon you got a Spiritual Charm. Report back to Zizzle.

You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. Start with the one in the north-west and work your way clockwise trough the room and kill those manifestation. Then use your sceptre on the remain to destroy the emperor's influence over the crystal.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 1 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 2 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed 3 of 4 emperor's influences.
You possess the key to enter the inner realms of the emperor. You destroyed all emperor's influences.
Your Mission is to kill Zalamon. Step into the teleporter to confront him. Finally use your sceptre on the death body.
Go back to Awareness Of The Emperor and report him your success!
The Emperor has promised you wealth beyond measure. Go claim it in the ministry.
You completed this Quest!

missions.name: To Take Roots
missions.description: Five Juicy roots from the outskirts of Rathleton may already help feed the poor. Try to find a city official to deliver them to or go to the Rathleton poor house.

states.description: You defeated the rogue Lady Tenebris.
You calmed poor, misguided Lloyd. All he wanted was protection from the outside world. Luckily he seems to have learned his lesson... or has he?
You defeated the Thorn Knight and shattered the root of evil with all your might. The honor of being a guardian of the glade indeed comes with pride as well as responsibility.
With help of Ivalisse from the temple of the Astral Shapers in Thais and her father, you averted the Dragon King's menace deep in the Zao Muggy Plains.
You saved the Dragon Mother's egg and she melted the ice wall that blocked your way.
You defeated the Time Guardian and are free to return to your own time. For some creatures in this world, it seems neither past nor future are an obstacle.
Description Fault.

missions.name: Treasure
missions.description: Treasure is the favorite of the dragon lords. Find and take Kalyassa's treasures spread across the world.

missions.name: Knowledge
missions.description: You learned that frost dragon's incitement is the thirst for knowledge, perhaps if you bring some to Gelidrazah's you'll meet him.

missions.name: Life
missions.description: Undead dragons aspires for life. No better way to see life as it grows around the world, is there?

states.description: Gerimor told you that the naturalist Jamesfrancis is an expert of minotaurs. Right now he is investigating a cave in minocity. But this time something seems to be completely different.
Jamesfrancis already entered the inner part of the cave weeks ago but had to flee when the minotaurs became too strong. He gave you the key to investigate this room as well.
You found an entrance to the minotaur boss. You killed it and now you have to return to Jamesfrancis.
Jamesfrancis sent you to talk with Gerimor about the minotaur cult.
You have reported the Druid of Crunor about the minotaur cult.
The Druid of Cronor gave you the hint that the Thais exhibition has expanded. The new section is called MOTA (Museum of Tibian Arts). It's really worth a visit.
Gareth told you how to become a patron of the arts. To fulfil your duty you have to manage some tasks. First you have to investigate the crime scene of a theft in the museum.
You found a ransom note, wich requests you to pay some money for the stolen picture to a stonge in Kazordoon. His name is Iwar. Nevertheless I should talk to Gareth first.
You told Gareth about the ransom note. He asked you to pay the money to Iwar to get the picture back. In his opinion, there is no alternative.
You paid the money to stooge in Kazordoon. You were told that the picture is delivered to Gareth himself.
You have to go to Angelo and get a magnifier to investigate all small pictures in the entrance hall of the MOTA. One of them should be a fake.
Angelo allowed you to take a magnifier from a crate next to the cave entrance.
You've fetched the magnifier from Angelo's crate. You're ready for your job in the museum.
Indeed! One of the investigated small pictures is fake. Report to Gareth!
After you told Gareth about the fake painting, he asked you to go to Angelo to get a new picture.
Angelo was not willing to give you a new picture. However, they havent found any artefact in the sandy cave yet. Report to Gareth about your failure.
Even though you weren't successful in getting a replacement for the fake picture, Gareth gave you access to the last floor of the museum. This area is for patrons only.
INTERNAL MESSAGE: THIS NEED QUESTLOG INFORMATION
The Denomintator opened the door for you after you answered his questions to the wanted number. In the end he mentioned the Druid of Conor. Maybe you should pay him a visit.
In the end you told the Druid of Crunor about your experiences in the MoTA.
The members of the Barkless follow a rigid path of hardship and sacrifice. Their cult is located somewhere beneath Ab'dendriel. Whatever happened to their leader, only a true Barkless can find out.
You survived the sulphur and tar trial. You accepted the stigma of misfortune and vanity. The hardest part, however, is yet to come. Give your life to the ice... to become true and purified.
You broke enough Barkless markings to now reverse the seal held up by the cult object in the ritual chamber. The power you gained feels unnatural and excessive but it seems ther is no other way.
Something far more powerful than the beliel of your Barkless brothers and sisters powered the seal to the leader. Whatever the case - find Leiden, or as he's known to his devotees: the "Penitent".
The Leiden you confronted has strayed far from his own original vision of Barkless. What you encountered was more monster than elf and less virtuous than his devotees would have you believe.
You returned to Gerimor after putting an end to the mischief of Leyden the Penitent. May the Barkless walk the true path again one day.
ASD
Below a ruin in the vicinity of the outlaw camp east of Thais a strange figure in ragged clothes hinted at something weird going on in a cave. He seemed too confused to decide whether to stop you.
You defeated the cult leader of Misguided by uncovering the true master to pull his strings and freeing this world from its malicious existance. Return to Gerimor to tell him about the victory.
You have spoken to Gerimor about your victory.
ASD
ASD
You returned to Gerimor after facing the being the orcs worshipped. Whatever it was, it did not find the orcs by accident. A far more powerful force seems to have strategically place it here.

missions.name: The Secret of the Sandy Cave

states.description: ASD
ASD
In the cave you haven't found one of the missing scientists. However, you have faced a lots of strange mummies and a green oasis at the end.
After you informed Angelo about your experiences in the cave, he asked you to go back to analyse the water of the oasis. For that reason you got an analysis tool.
You have analysed the water with the help of the analysis tool from Angelo.
You informed Angelo about the analyzed water. He gave you a counteragent, wich you have to apply to the oasis.
You applied the counteragent to the oasis, just like Angelo had asked you to. But the effect was different from what you had expected. A sandstorm approached and caused create damage to the oasis.
You Killed the boss
You reported your victory to Angelo
You have told Gerimor about your stay in the sandy cave. He was not really surprised and felt vindicated that the rumors about a cult in the cave might be true.
ASD
You returned to Gerimor after encounter with the remnants of Zathroth. On one hand its is furtunate that Zathroth indeed wasn't behind all this, but on the other... what is going on there?
You drove off the Lost but more are sure to come. Check back with Klom Stonecutter at a later time.
You helped Klom defend the outpost by cutting down a number of vermin from deep down below. The gnomes don't seem to completely approve of this but everyone appreciates the drop in the enemy's ranks.
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
Gnomus sent you to find and rescue the gnome ordnance the outpost is currently waiting for. Travel to the east of the cave system and find the old gnome trail where reinforcements will arrive.
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
You helped Gnomus chart the area around the deep base. You found traces of what could have been an old civilisation but there's not enough left to draw any conclusion.
You helped Lardoc Bashsmite fighting back the verminous growth in the northern mineshaft. Return to him later to see if he has more work for you.
You reported back to Lardoc Bashsmite to inform him that the gnome's plan to neutralise diremaw corpses seems to work.
At the Kha'zeel Mountains you met the merchant Tarun. His brother has gone missing and was last seen following a beautiful woman into a palace. Tarun fears this woman might have been a demon.
You found the remains of Tarun's brother containing a message. Go back to Tarun and report his brother's last words.
You told Tarun about his brother's sad fate. He was very downhearted but gave you his sincere thanks. The beautiful asuri have taken a young man's life and the happiness of another one.

missions.name: In the Adventures Outpost
missions.description: You have reached the Outpost, where young heroes are trained in combat and hunting. When you have reached level 8 at least, you can leave for the Mainland. Talk to Inigo if you have questions.

states.description: Mr Morris tasked you to find an ancient amulet that was lost somewhere on Dawnport - probably next to a corpse somewhere.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks for you the help.
Mr Morris urged you to find a log book that was stolen by trolls.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.
Mr Morris needs the rare Dawnfire herb harvested and brought to him. It grows on gray sand only, he said.
Come back to Mr Morris.
Mr Morris thanks you for the help.
The key to the adventurer's dormitory has disappeared. Maybe you can find it. Ask around to find out who was the last to have seen it.
Use the fishing rod in the nearby lake to fish Old Nasty.
Come back to Woblin with Old Nasty
Come back to Mr Morris with Key 0010
Mr Morris thanks for the help

missions.name: Mission 01: A Taste of Things to Come

states.description: Vascalir promised you some equipment, but first you need to build up some muscles. Find a big pile of stone in a barn to the north and use it to get a heavy stone.
You retrieved one stone from the big pile. Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to use it on.
You loaded a stone on one of the catapults. One more to go! Climb onto the roof of either Norma's bar, Obi's shop or the academy to find a catapult to load with a heavy stone.
Two of the four catapults on the roofs are loaded. That should be enough to build up a decent defence. Return to Vascalir to turn in your quest.
You made sure that Rookgaard's defences are at their best. If the orcs try to enter the village, they won't have an easy time!
Vascalir doesn't have a job for you at the moment. He sent you to Lily in the south-west of town for another mission.
Lily gave you a bag with fresh herbs that need to be delivered to Hyacinth outside of the village. Leave the village to the north and walk east to find his little hut up a mountain.
You've delivered the fresh herbs to Hyacinth. He still has a reward for you though - make sure to talk to him again!
Hyacinth has another reward for you - make sure to talk to him again with enough space in your inventory.
You've delivered the herbs to Hyacinth and got potions and a ring as reward. Save the potions for when you're low on health and wear the ring if you want to regain health faster. Return to Vascalir.
You've told Vascalir about your successful delivery. The next mission awaits.
Vascalir sent you to the spider queen's lair to retrieve a web sample. Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the north-west to find the lair. Look for greasy blue stones.
You've covered yourself in grease. It's a bit disgusting, but the spider queen will not be able to smell you for about two minutes. Enter her cave and USE an intact spider web to retrieve a sample.
You retrieved some of the spider queen's web. Return to Vascalir and try not to get caught by the queen on the way out!
The spider queen caught you in her net. If you had a sample of her web, you've lost it. Find a way out of her net and retry!
Vascalir took the sample from you. He still has a studded armor for you - talk to him once you have enough space in your inventory.
You've brought the spider queen's web back to Vascalir. This will definitely come in handy later on.
Vascalir sent you to Tom the Tanner, who can be found to the west of the academy. There you will get your next mission.
Leave the village to the north and walk north-east into the forest to find the wolves' den that Tom told you about. Hopefully you will find that poacher to take some leather from him!
You've entered the wolves' den - that was a one-way fall, but luckily you didn't get hurt. The poacher you were looking for is dead - but that doesn't mean you can't get some war wolf leather!
You've skinned a war wolf - but you alerted the wolf pack! Run to the exit, quickly!
RUN! You have only a limited time to reach the exit with the war wolf leather!
Phew - you managed to get out of the wolves' den in time. Return to Tom to finish your mission.
Tom gave you a pair of leather boots as reward for your good work. Vascalir surely has a new mission for you now.
While you were gone, trolls have infiltrated the academy and set it on fire! Enter the burning vault deep underground and try to recover the copy of the book of orc language before it's destroyed.
You've done all you could - but unfortunately the book is lost. No need to lose heart though - there is still hidden knowledge about the orc language in the village, and the next mission awaits.
Before getting revenge on the trolls, eliminate the risk of losing money on the way. Paulie has an interesting bonus offer for you if you deposit your money at the bank. Find him below the academy.
You've done as Vascalir asked and talked to Paulie. Remember to always leave your gold on your account! That way there's no risk of losing it.
Enter the troll lair to the north of the village and find the new tunnel which the trolls dug and used to infiltrate the Rookgaard academy. There, you need to find a way to destroy it.
Open the chests in the tunnel and use the pick on the 5 beams to weaken the structure and make the tunnel collapse.
You've weakened one of five beams.
You've weakened two of five beams.
You've weakened three of five beams.
You've weakened four of five beams.
You've weakened all the beams! Hurry out of the tunnel before it collapses!
The tunnel collapsed behind you. Time to return to Vascalir.
Vascalir rewarded you with experience, but there's still something he has to give you. You should talk to him again.
The trolls will not be able to enter the academy via their tunnel again. The village is safe for now - at least from trolls.
Leave the village to the north and walk south-east to find the haunted graveyard. Descend into the crypt and find a sarcophagus that might still contain a fleshy bone. Bring it to Vascalir.
You've brought the fleshy bone back to Vascalir. Talk to him again to receive your reward.
You managed to get a fleshy bone from the crypt! Who knows what Vascalir plans with it - but this is going to be good.
Leave the village to the north and cross the bridge to the west, then walk south-west to find a wasp lair. Make sure you don't lose the flask Vascalir gave you.
You've found the wasp lair. Kill one wasp and use the empty flask on its dead body to retrieve some of its poison.
You've retrieved some lethal wasp poison. Bring it back to Vascalir to complete the mission.
You brought Vascalir the highly toxic poison. You should talk to him again to receive your reward.
You've retrieved highly toxic wasp poison for Vascalir. It's time for your final challenge.
This is it - the infiltration of the orc fortress and revenge on Kraknaknork awaits. Get the required items from a chest in the academy near the bank.
You've got all items you need to finally kill Kraknaknork. Don't lose them, and carefully make your way towards the orc fortress located in the far west of Rookgaard. Leave the village to the north.
You've knocked out the unsuspecting orc. USE the orc before it wakes up again to disguise yourself as an orc!
Even your mom wouldn't recognise you. You might not be able to fool all orcs in your disguise, but it should be enough to walk past the orc guarding the entrance.
You managed to sneak into the fortress. Use the fleshy bone and click on the elite orc guard with the crosshairs to create a distraction!
The guard is indeed very distracted - he smells delicious. At least to the wild dogs that entered the scene. This is the perfect time to enter the lower levels of the orc fortress.
You're inside the orc fortress! Now you need to find a kitchen and something that looks like a soup cauldron. Use the wasp poison on the cauldron to create an evil surprise for Kraknaknork.
You "spiced up" Kraknaknork's breakfast. Let's see how strong he still is after his meal. Proceed further into the fortress - and keep your tarantula trap ready.
You managed to slow down the furious orc berserker. Now, run through the teleporter while he isn't close to it!
You've entered Kraknaknork's room. Find a way to get rid of the energy barriers.
You solved the riddle of the energy barriers. The way to the throne room should be clear - for a short time. Be prepared for a massive fight!
You've entered Kraknaknork's throne room. Fight him! You can back out at any time via the teleporter, but you'll have to start the battle over. Once he is dead, enter the teleporter near his throne.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and found his treasure room. You can probably take a few things from there before you leave - he wouldn't care anymore.
With the last bit of Kraknaknork's energy, you were teleported out of the fortress. Time to return to Vascalir victoriously.
You've vanquished Kraknaknork and brought peace to the village of Rookgaard. It will soon be time for you to leave for the Isle of Destiny, choose a vocation and enter the open world of Tibia.
Explore the new land and reach the bottom of the mountain.
You have found a passage from the mountains. You can report back to Ongulf.
You have reported the scouted route to Ongulf.
Find Melfar of the imperial mining guild close to a mine entrance west of Kazordoon. Ask him to send more miners and wood.
Prepare the three trees which Melfar marked on your map with the beaver bait. Once you've marked all three return to Melfar and tell him about your success.
Melfar has finally promised to send more miners and wood. Report this to Ongulf in Farmine.
You have reported that Melfar will send more miners and wood for Farmine.
Find the unknown stalkers somewhere in the mountains. They apparently climbed up somewhere during their escape. Try to negotiate a peaceful agreement if possible.
You have talked to the leader of the primitive humans and have assured their peacefulness. Report this to Ongulf back in the base.
You have negotiated a peacful agreement between the dwarfs and the local primitives.
Free the mine of the monstrous threat. Use a lift to reach the mines and look for a leader of the stone creatures. Slay this creature and report back to Ongulf.
You have slain the monster that terrorised the mines.
Try getting the support of the people mentioned. Talk to them about "farmine", then choose the "flatter", "threaten", "impress", "bluff", "reason" or "plea" and report any progress to Ongulf.
You have gained the necessary support for Farmine.

missions.name: Mission 08: An Offer You Can't Refuse

states.description: Captured by lizardmen trap you have to find a way out of the prison. Perhaps something in your cell might lead you to an opportunity for freedom.
You managed to find a way of the captivity of the lizardmen - but for a price.
You are expected to participate in the great tournament of the lizard race. Travel to the Isle of Strife and brave the challenges there.
You are the champion of the great tournament! Still the lizardmen are a menace to behold. You should report to Chrak before you leave the isle.
You have reported your latest doings to Chrak. It seems you bought the dwarfs some time of peace. Only the dragon kings may know how long though.
Ongulf will be anxious to learn about your latest adventures. Travel back to Farmine for a final report.
Ongulf got very satisfied with your journey, this land is yours to be taken. You can find now on top of the mountain a red carpet, it might offer you access to some cities.
You brought the fist Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the lizard culture. Pompan will sell you dragon tapestries from now on.
You brought the second Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the minotaur culture. Pompan will sell you minotaur backpacks from now on.
You brought the third Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the draken culture. Esrik will sell you lizard weapon rack from now on.

You brought the fourth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about a certain food that the lizardmen apparently prepare. Swolt will trade you a bunch of ripe rice for 10 rice balls from now on.
You brought the fifth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizards in the South, Zzaion. Pompan will sell you lizard backpacks from now on.
You brought the sixth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about the primitive human culture on this continent. Cael will sell you War Drums and Didgeridoo from now on.
You brought the seventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Zao steppe. Now you to use the snake teleport at the peak of the mountain.
You brought the eighth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt a few things about an illness. Now you can enter a corruption hole in the north-eastern end of Zao.
You brought the ninth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about the Draken origin. Esrik will buy lizard equipment from you now.

You brought the tenth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt more about the last stand of the lizard dynasty. Now you can enter the Zao Palace. It is situated deep underground, below the mountain base of the Lizards.
You brought the eleventh Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something interesting about dragons and their symbolism. You can buy a Dragon Statue from NPC Cael after you bring him a Red Lantern.

You brought the twelfth Tome of Knowledge to Cael. He learnt something about reveals some of the power structures in Zao. Cael will now make a Dragon Throne for you after you bring him a Red Piece of Cloth. He will reward you with 5000 experience points for each extra tome you give to him.
Use the item on the tombstones.
You have used these item in the tombstones.
Talk to Sinclair and take the ghost residue.
You got the ghost waste.
You need to get more samples of ghosts.
You got all the ghost scraps.
You met the talking white deer Alkestios. It turned out he is actually a fae - and needs help. Search out a poacher camp north of the Green Claw Swamps and keep the poachers from hunting white deers.
You found a book with legends in the poacher camp. You asked Ahmed to add a story about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer, hopefully the poachers will desist from hunting Alkestios.
You returned to the poacher camp and placed the faked book noticeably on a table. You're quite sure the poachers will discover it soon and desist from hunting Alkestios.
Alkestios asked you for help on another issue. There seemms to be a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. Find the snake Ikassis in the north-west of Edron and talk to her, she knows more.
The snake Ikassis asked you to find a female wolf in the south of Cormaya. The animal is in need of help, yet Ikassis didn't know any details.
You found the ghostly wolf and promised to search for her lost whelps. The wolf told you to start your search at Ulderek's Rock
At Ulderek's Rock you found a sleeping war wolf. It might actually be the now grown up whelp you were looking for. The skeleton nearby implies that the hunter didn't survive his misdeed.
You talked to Irmana in Venore and she gave you the fur of one of the wolf whelps you're searching for. You should talk to their mother's ghost.
As the ghostly wolf asked you, you placed the whelp fur in the mouth of a nearby stone, that is shaped like a big face.
You redeemed the ghostly wolf. You should return to Ikassis and tell her about it.
Ikassis was happy to hear that you redeemed the ghostly wolf. But she asked you to help someone else: one of her sisters. You can find her in the guise of swan at a river sourth-east of Ikassis.
You met a swan that in truth is a swan maiden, a kind of fae. These fae have magical cloaks that allow them to shape change between swan and girl. Find this maiden's cloak that was stolen by a troll.
The troll Grarkharok sold the cloak to Tereban and he lost it during a flight with magic carpet. The cloak's feathers are now scattered along the carpet's beeline between Edron and Darashia.
You found many swan feathers on Edron and in Darama desert. Now you should have enough for an entire cloak. You should talk to the swan maiden.
You found enough magical swan feathers. The swan maiden will now be able to restore her cloak. You should talk to Alkestios again.
Alkestios was very happy about your support. You earned the Fae's trust and may now enter their secret realm. Search for an elemental shrine of ice, fire, earth or energy to reach Feyrist.
You killed 200 of the nightmare monsters that are invading Feyrist. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she still has other problems. She may need your help once more.
Maelyrra asked you to retrieve an artefact for her: the moon mirror. It was stolen by the tainted fae who inhabit the caves underneath Feyrist. She also asked you to free some captured fairies.
You found the moon mirror and freed the captured fairies. Maelyrra was very happy but it seems she has another problem. Perhaps you should offer your assistance once more.
The barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world is weakened. To strengthen it again you need to find the starlight vial and the sun catcher. Ask Aurita and Taegen for these items.
Gather sunlight, starlight and moon rays. You have to do this with the sun catcher on the beach, with the starlight vial high in the mountains and with the moon mirror on a glade in the forest.
You may now repair the barrier. Charge the five moon sculptures of Feyrist with moon rays, the five dreambird trees with starlight and the five sun mosics with sunlight.
You repaired tha magical barrier that protects Feyrist from the outside world. The fae's secret realm is safe again.
Help Aurita and Taegen and find a spell to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. A fairy in a small fae village in the southwest of Feyrist might know more.
You have succesfully created the magical music notes for the mermaid Aurita. Talk to the faun Taegen, he also needs your help.
The faun Taegen wants to spend some time with his lover, the mermaid Aurita. He wants to visit her home and thus must be able to breath under water. Therefore he needs the rare raven herb.
You found the rare raven herb and gave it to Taegen. Now he will create a sun catcher for you. You may also ask Aurita for the starlight vial now.
Think of a way to earn Julius' trust and prove that you are not a vampire. Once you thought of something, talk to him again about your mission.
You have Julius' trust.
Bake garlic cookies by using the garlic dough on a baking tray before you put it on the oven. Hand out cookies to the citizens and watch their reactions. Report any suspicious people to Julius.
You have reported five suspects - probably vamires - to Julius.
Use the magic words 'alori mort' in front of the suspicious citizens you discovered to hopefully reveal who among them is their leader.
You reported the incident with Armenius to Julius.
Your task is to find someone to bring you to Vengoth. Explore the island and use Julius' map whenever you find an unusual spot to mark it. Mark at least 5 spots including the castle and report back.
